DARV.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0-0: Hey there, young lady! Been summoned to climb the tower too, have you? The road up is no joke!
DARV.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0-1: Thanks — I'll keep that in mind!
DARV.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-0: I'm swamped right now — go on, pick yourself something from that pile!
DARV.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-1: How strange — you're giving things away without asking for anything in return?
NEOW.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0-0: We meet again, big one! Was it you who brought me back this time, too?
NEOW.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-0: By the way — have you just been waiting here all along for the right person to climb the tower?
NEOW.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-1: Kill... the Architect... any price... must be paid...
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHY: You carry the scent of sandstorms, and the keenness of a lion.
Darling, such bright eyes you have. I think these would make them shine even brighter.
Ah, sorry — too many ornaments would just get in my way out in the field.
Then take them along with you.
OROBAS.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0: New friend! So hot! Burns eye?
Oh — sorry. With only one eye, you really do have to take good care of it.
OROBAS.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1: This place reminds me of Port Ormos... the salty tang of the sea wind — so different from the desert.
Desert! No water? No swimming? Not fun?
The children of the desert got used to it long ago.
OROBAS.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.2: Hahaha — I'm glad to call you a friend, too!
PAEL.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0-0: Where I come from, a clay dragon like you would have baked to dust under the sun long ago.
PAEL.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-0: (The great dragon slumbers on, its snoring rumbling through the whole chamber...)
PAEL.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.1-1: I'd better not disturb your rest, then.
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHY: It's so much warmer in here than anywhere else... reminds me of the sun over the deserts of Sumeru.
Drink this soup, child — it will warm you right up.
Have some hot soup before you go, child.
Mm — thank you. Don't mind if I do.
VAKUU.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_DEHYA.0-: Sign this contract, and my blessing and protection are yours. What do you say — quite the bargain, no?
I've seen plenty of contracts — but never one that so boldly lined the drafter's own pockets.
Everyone dies for money, my dear — the bird dies for food.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS2_DEHYA_CHARACTER_: Oh — so this is the top of the tower.
Go back. You do not belong here.
At least say a few words before sending me back? So the master of the tower is this rude a man.
Outsiders should not ask so much.
We meet again, Architect. This time, I'm not simply turning back.
...Why this obsession? You have no stake in this tower.
A mercenary sees a commission through to the end — that's my code.
